scope: AST isolated full route, no PCB output

limitations: 2A is a design target, not thermal certification.
SO8 parallel-pin current sharing, connector ratings, copper thickness, startup/stall and temperature rise require validation.
Default .3mm vias may serve low-current branches only; the independent wide-tree path never uses them.

independent_audit.note: Assigned-layer wide trees only: GND on back through existing >=0.8mm plated THT, others front. Thermal, hole-wall current, startup/stall, pin sharing and connector capability unverified.

power_audit.note: Assigned-layer wide trees only: GND on back through existing >=0.8mm plated THT, others front. Thermal, hole-wall current, startup/stall, pin sharing and connector capability unverified.
